title: Lucknow Zoo - A Perfect Wildlife Escape in the Heart of the City
content:
Lucknow Zoo

Lucknow Zoo, officially known as Nawab Wajid Ali Shah Zoological Garden, is one of the most popular tourist attractions in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Spread over a large green area in the center of the city, this zoo is a favorite spot for families, children, nature lovers, and wildlife enthusiasts. It offers a refreshing break from city life while giving visitors a chance to see animals from across the world.

Location & Overview

Lucknow Zoo is located near Hazratganj, making it easily accessible from all parts of the city. Established in 1921, the zoo is named after Nawab Wajid Ali Shah, the last ruler of Awadh. With its well-maintained gardens, wide pathways, and peaceful environment, it is an ideal place for a day outing.

Animals & Attractions

The zoo is home to a wide variety of animals, birds, and reptiles. Some of the main attractions include:

  • Royal Bengal Tiger 
  • Asiatic Lion 
  • White Tiger
  • Leopard, Bear, and Hyena
  • Giraffe, Zebra, and Rhinoceros
  • Crocodiles and various snakes
  • Colorful birds like parrots, peacocks, and owls

The enclosures are designed to resemble natural habitats, making the experience enjoyable and educational.

Toy Train Ride

One of the highlights of Lucknow Zoo is the toy train, especially loved by children. It takes visitors around the zoo, offering a fun and relaxed way to explore the premises.

State Museum Inside the Zoo

Inside the zoo campus, you will also find the Uttar Pradesh State Museum. It displays ancient sculptures, coins, fossils, paintings, and artifacts related to the rich history and culture of the region. This makes the visit more informative and meaningful.

A Green & Peaceful Environment

Lucknow Zoo is not just about animals; it is also a beautiful green space. Tall trees, flowering plants, and open lawns make it perfect for walking, photography, and relaxing with family and friends.

Timings & Best Time to Visit

The zoo usually opens in the morning and remains open till evening, except on Mondays.
The best time to visit is during winter months (October to March) when the weather is pleasant and animals are more active.

Entry Fee

The entry fee is very affordable, with separate charges for adults, children, camera, and toy train rides. Prices may vary, so it’s best to check locally before visiting.

Ideal for All Ages

Lucknow Zoo is a perfect destination for:

  • Family outings
  • School trips
  • Nature and wildlife lovers
  • Photography enthusiasts

Children especially enjoy watching animals and learning about wildlife in a fun way.

Tips for Visitors

  • Wear comfortable shoes as you’ll walk a lot.
  • Carry water bottles, especially in summer.
  • Follow zoo rules and don’t feed animals.
  • Visit early to avoid crowds and heat.

Nearby Places to Visit

After visiting the zoo, you can also explore:

  • Hazratganj Market  - for shopping and food
  • Ambedkar Memorial Park
  • Janeshwar Mishra Park
  • Residency (British Residency)

All are located within a short distance.
excerpt: Lucknow Zoo is a famous wildlife attraction in the heart of the city, home to tigers, lions, birds, and reptiles. It also houses the UP State Museum and offers a fun toy train ride for kids. Perfect for families, nature lovers, and a peaceful day outing in Lucknow.
